name: Mycelium
description: Contaminateur infectant les équipements ennemis avec des spores corrosives affaiblissant leur efficacité opérationnelle.

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes végétales avec mycéliums s'étendant comme des membres. Champignons et moisissures colorés. Spores flottantes en halo. Présence organique dérangeante.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (adjacent_on_flip) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Everyday working pose, natural stance — character shown in their normal operational state — Shockwave exploding outward when flipped, affecting adjacent cards in a chain reaction

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Toxic Green
palette_names.role: primary_accent — fungal growths and spore clouds

palette_names.name: Decay Brown
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — decomposing surfaces and organic matter

palette_names.name: Flesh Pink
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — exposed tissue and infected areas

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Flat ambient light with subtle shadows, documentary-style natural lighting

camera.angle: eye-level direct portrait creating a sense of honest documentation

scenography.setting: Infested corridor overtaken by fungal growth, thick mycelial networks covering every surface, pulsating fungal towers, spore clouds reducing visibility
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Floating spore particles in dense clouds, pulsating organic growths slowly expanding, dripping fungal fluids, organic tendrils reaching and grasping, plus death explosion — radial burst affecting nearby targets as the card flips visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Contaminateur infectant les équipements ennemis avec des spores corrosives affaiblissant leur efficacité opérationnelle.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Le Fléau Spore est une entité fongique cosmique se propageant imparable. Chaque spore contient la conscience collective. Il étend, consomme, transforme.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Brushed steel frame with simple geometric pattern, no ornamentation, utilitarian finish
card_metadata.composition_directive: Medium close-up portrait (chest-up) showing character face and upper torso in their working environment
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
